out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Described “spherical (360 surround) out-of-body vision… seeing from all sides and angles, in and out of my body all at once,” like “cameras 30 feet outside myself looking in at all angles.”
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Separation described as being “sucked out of the moment into a warm void.”

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as “a tube… a direct path, a wormhole.”
tunnel.movement_other_detail: “Blasted… through a wormhole” and “felt all sorts of beings graze me as I flew through them.”

arrival.other_being_detail: Mentions “extra-terrestrial things” and “all sorts of spirits” encountered along the wormhole; no single figure described in detail.

environment.environment_other_detail: Primary realm described as “a warm void… timeless space,” with an “event horizon” pull between darkness (death) and a distant “tiny speck of white light” (life). Later, upon return to the accident moment, reports seeing “electromagnetic fields surrounding most everything.”

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Framed as choosing life vs death: “I had a choice… decided to nudge towards LIFE… came back to Earth to affirm my decision to live.”
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: States returning “with a mission… the lesson I have to teach… how to integrate the old self with my new self, now full love, lightness, and enthusiasm.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bicycle collision: “hit head-on by a car… black SUV… ~60 mph… forehead touched the windshield.”

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Says: “I was not very spiritual before my NDE.”
person_demographics.occupation: Design school student; competitive swimmer on scholarship

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reports perceiving “electromagnetic fields” upon re-entering the accident moment; describes “unattachment” dissolution of identity; beings “grazing” during wormhole return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE at impact → void → extensive life-memory dissolution/life review → timeless minimal-self state → distant white light and death/life polarity (boundary/choice) → wormhole/tube return with beings → re-entry into accident moment with heightened perception → physical survival sequence.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Describes perceiving body “from all sides… in and out of my body all at once,” and later seeing body plus surrounding electromagnetic fields during the same frozen “nanosecond.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: “Spherical (360 surround) out-of-body vision”; “unattachment” from every life perception and then from “gravity, mass, electricity”; perceived “event horizon” between death-pull and a tiny white light identified as life; beings “grazing” during wormhole return including “extra-terrestrial things”; perception of electromagnetic fields around body upon return; intentional stiffening of head/neck/brain to break windshield.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was sucked out of the moment into a warm void.” “I was nothing but a figment of knowledge that ‘I’ existed.” “I had a choice… decided to nudge towards LIFE.” “It felt like a tube, a direct path, a wormhole.” “I saw the electromagnetic fields surrounding most everything.” “you are a miracle.”
